name: Mk I
title: Smart siddur, first mark
notes: Smart Ashkenaz siddur web app, mourner tools, HIG design, build pipeline and handoff system.

name: Mk II
title: In-app updates
notes: The Android app can update itself from .oleh files on GitHub, only when you tap. Includes tilt to turn pages.

name: Mk III
title: Kindle-style reading
notes: Light, Paper, Dark and Auto themes, Aa sheet, page progress, tap zones, Android system bars that follow the theme.

name: Mk IV
title: Paged book layout
notes: Real page-by-page reading with page numbers and running headers, paper texture, Dark Paper theme.

name: Mk V
title: Slider fix
notes: The text size slider always keeps its last value.

name: Mk VI
title: Page flip
notes: Pages turn with a real 3D page flip, with a switch in Settings to turn it off.
